ห้องรับประทานอาหารตกแต่งไม้ (Wood-panelled dining room): A dining room seen from a standing position at a front-left angle, in soft daylight. Walls are cream with oak trim strips; the white ceiling has three recessed stained-glass panels in yellow-green with oak frames. Centre: one long rectangular oak dining table with four square lantern-like lamps on posts at its corners and two white candles in tall green-bronze candlesticks. Around it are about nine tall straight-backed oak chairs with dark leather seats: one armchair at front left, three on the far side, three on the near side, one at the right end, and one separate chair at far right front. Back wall: a built-in oak sideboard with drawers, topped by an upper cabinet with seven leaded-glass doors and one solid wooden door, holding green vases and bowls; a dark vessel sits in a lit niche at each end. Left wall: a framed green landscape painting. Right: a bronze statue of a dancing figure on a tall oak pedestal, a small wall sconce, a wooden door, and tall leaded-glass windows. Floor: hardwood with a pale rug with a red-and-green border.
